title: Mission-Level Runtime Assurance for LLM-Assisted ISR Swarms over a Verification-Aware Fabric
abstract: arXiv:2607.23532v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Swarms of LLM-assisted autonomous robots are increasingly proposed for cooperative intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) in contested environments. A growing class of their assurance failures arises not within any single platform but across the swarm: individually-compliant actions compose into a mission-level violation: a prohibited objective split across platforms to evade per-platform limits, or a collective budget quietly exceeded. Per-platform guardrails miss these by construction, and contested communications let the violation hide behind lost or delayed evidence. We present a three-tier (platform/squad/mission) compositional runtime-verification framework that decomposes a mission policy into per-agent and cross-agent aspects, aggregates per-platform verdicts over a verification-aware messaging fabric, and fuses them with an evidence-aware, two-axis (security x completeness) algebra whose provenance names

translated_title: 基于验证感知架构的LLM辅助ISR蜂群任务级运行时保障
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.23532v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：LLM辅助的自主机器人蜂群正越来越多地被提议用于对抗环境中的协同情报、监视与侦察（ISR）任务。其保障失效的一个日益增长的类别并非出现在任何单个平台内部，而是出现在蜂群层面：各自合规的动作组合起来却构成任务级违规——例如将一个被禁止的目标拆分到多个平台上以规避单平台限制，或者悄然超出集体预算。单平台防护栏在结构上无法捕捉此类违规，而对抗性通信环境则使违规行为能够借助丢失或延迟的证据得以隐藏。我们提出了一个三层（平台/小队/任务）组合式运行时验证框架，该框架将任务策略分解为单代理与跨代理层面，通过验证感知的消息传递架构聚合各平台的判定结果，并将其与一种证据感知的双轴（安全性×完整性）代数融合，该代数的溯源机制可对……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一个平台/小队/任务三层组合式运行时验证框架，借助验证感知消息架构与证据感知的双轴（安全性×完整性）代数，捕捉LLM辅助ISR机器人蜂群中由单平台合规动作组合而成的任务级违规。
en_tdlr: We present a three-tier (platform/squad/mission) compositional runtime-verification framework that captures mission-level violations arising from individually-compliant actions in LLM-assisted ISR robot swarms, by aggregating per-platform verdicts over a verification-aware messaging fabric and fusing them with an evidence-aware two-axis (security × completeness) algebra.
